name: Ijimeru Nara, Watashi no Karada ni Shite! ~Musuko no Kawari ni, Suki Houdai Sareru Haha~
original_name: 虐めるなら、私の身体にして！ ～息子の代わりに、好き放題される母～
source:
"Please bully me instead of my son! I'll do anything."

Although Masano was widowed at a young age, she impressively raised her son, Hiroshi, alone.

The mother and her son live happily ever after, or so it should be, until she discovers that her son has been bullied.

A mother's love for her child, the will of a single parent. She eventually confronts the people who are bullying her son, in exchange for stopping her son's bullying, she makes a deal with their leader.

"――Don't lay a hand on my son. In exchange......"

As a mother, all she wants is to protect her son.
However, in the midst of her willingly severe suffering, a woman's true nature hidden within her awakens.

Is this an amicable mother or a woman drowning in lust and pleasures.
What she really wants, that is――

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1241380]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
“请欺负我而不是我的儿子！我会做任何事。”

正野虽然年轻时就丧偶，但她独自抚养儿子弘志，令人印象深刻。

母亲和她的儿子从此过着幸福的生活，或者说应该如此，直到她发现她的儿子被欺负了。

母亲对孩子的爱，单亲父母的心愿。她最终面对那些欺负她儿子的人，作为制止她儿子欺凌的交换条件，她与他们的领袖做了一笔交易。

“——别对我儿子下手。作为交换……”

作为一个母亲，她唯一的愿望就是保护自己的儿子。
然而，在她心甘情愿地遭受剧烈痛苦的过程中，隐藏在她内心的女人的本性觉醒了。

这是一个和蔼可亲的母亲，还是一个沉浸在情欲和享乐之中的女人。
她真正想要的，那就是——

[翻译和编辑自 [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1241380]Getchu[/url]]
